name: A centered multicolor sprite rotates 45 degrees without new colors
description: Drawing a small asymmetric two-color sprite near the canvas center and using RotSprite at 45 degrees produces a visible rotated shape whose edges retain the chosen colors.

planSteps.description: Draw a short red vertical stroke near the canvas center
Choose a contrasting blue drawing color
Draw a short blue horizontal stroke joined to the red stroke
Verify the canvas shows one rotated, connected shape rather than scattered pixels, with the original red and blue colors and transparent background
Verify no clipping warning appears and neither stroke disappears

name: An edge-touching sprite refuses a rotation that would clip pixels
description: A sprite painted against the canvas edge remains unchanged when a 45-degree RotSprite turn would place pixels beyond the canvas.

planSteps.description: Draw one short stroke touching the top-left canvas corner
Draw a second short stroke touching the bottom-right canvas corner
Verify a rotation clipping message appears in the studio
Verify both corner strokes remain at their original positions and keep their original colors

name: A quarter-turn rotates pixels exactly and undo restores the drawing
description: RotSprite at 90 degrees moves an asymmetric drawing to its exact quarter-turn position, and Undo returns it to the original positions and colors.

planSteps.description: Draw an asymmetric L-shaped stroke near the canvas center
Verify the L shape is rotated by one quarter turn with crisp pixels and its original color
Verify the original L shape returns to its earlier position and orientation without color loss
